steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Shoulder joint: Ball-and-socket joint allowing a wide range of movement including flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, rotation and circumduction. | Elbow joint: Hinge joint allowing only flexion and extension. | Hip joint: Ball-and-socket joint allowing flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, rotation and circumduction. | Knee joint: Hinge joint (modified) allowing primarily flexion and extension, with slight rotation when flexed.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Identify the joint, movement and agonist muscle when a cricketer bowls the ball forward. | Describe the movement at the knee during the upward phase of a squat and name the agonist muscle. | What movement occurs at the shoulder during the arm-raising phase of a star jump? Name the agonist muscle.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Shoulder joint, Elbow joint, Hip joint, and one past-paper question.
